6. Check the observation: if predictions contain valid bounding boxes, record as positive.
7. Compare results: Select the option with valid grounding boxes. If both have boxes, prefer the one with higher confidence or more precise localization if available; if neither has boxes, re-evaluate using an expert VQA tool.
